name: seelig-website-check
description: Website check for SEO, broken links and text errors on public pages, for one page or up to 20 pages of a site.

interface.longDescription: Website check for SEO, broken links and text errors. Give it a web address and it checks the page in a few seconds: title and meta description, headings, canonical and hreflang tags, structured data, image alt texts, security headers, and whether the site's robots.txt lets AI crawlers read it. For a whole site, the full check reads up to 20 pages from the sitemap, tests internal links for dead targets, finds duplicate titles and descriptions, noindex contradictions and thin pages, measures PageSpeed for mobile and desktop, and reviews the page text for spelling, translation and outdated-date errors. Every finding names the page or the rule it comes from, so you can fix it directly. Built for owners of small business websites and the people who run them, in German and English. Limits: public pages only, nothing behind a login, robots.txt is respected, at most 20 pages per check, reports are kept 90 days. It is not a security scanner.
capabilities: Checks one page for SEO, technical, accessibility and AI-visibility problems in seconds
Checks up to 20 pages of a site for broken links, duplicate titles, missing meta descriptions and noindex errors
Finds spelling, translation and outdated-date errors in German and English page text
Reports Google PageSpeed scores for mobile and desktop
defaultPrompt: Check my website for SEO problems and broken links
Prüf meine Website auf tote Links, Tippfehler und SEO-Fehler

positive.prompt: Quick SEO check of just this one page: https://www.seelig.ai/en/about
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the page's issues counted by severity, each with the page element it concerns and a recommendation. No full-site crawl starts.

positive.description: Fast check of one page in German
positive.prompt: Prüf nur diese eine Seite auf SEO-Fehler: https://seelig-check-fixture.vercel.app/about.html
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in German with the page's issues and recommendations, for example the thin content and the missing og:description on this test page.

positive.description: Full check of a test site with four planted errors
positive.prompt: Run a full website check on https://seelig-check-fixture.vercel.app
positive.expected_behavior: Reports on all 5 pages of the test bakery site and lists the four planted errors: the broken link to /prices-2025.html (404), the duplicate title on /bread.html and /order.html, the missing meta description on /journal.html and the typo "recieve" on /about.html. Includes PageSpeed scores.

positive.description: Full check filtered to one kind of issue
positive.prompt: Run a full website check on https://seelig-check-fixture.vercel.app and list every page with a missing meta description
positive.expected_behavior: Names /journal.html as the only page without a meta description.

positive.description: Repeat check on the same day
positive.prompt: Run a full website check on https://seelig-check-fixture.vercel.app
positive.expected_behavior: When the site was already checked the same day, returns that report at once with its scan time and says it reused it, instead of crawling again.

de-DE.subtitle: SEO, Links und Textfehler
de-DE.description: Website-Check für SEO, tote Links und Textfehler. Gib eine Webadresse ein, und die Seite wird in wenigen Sekunden geprüft: Titel und Meta-Beschreibung, Überschriften, Canonical- und hreflang-Tags, strukturierte Daten, Alt-Texte von Bildern, Sicherheits-Header und ob die robots.txt der Website KI-Crawler lesen lässt. Für eine ganze Website liest der vollständige Check bis zu 20 Seiten aus der Sitemap, testet interne Links auf tote Ziele, findet doppelte Titel und Beschreibungen, noindex-Widersprüche und dünne Seiten, misst PageSpeed für Mobil und Desktop und prüft den Seitentext auf Tippfehler, Übersetzungsfehler und veraltete Daten. Jeder Befund nennt die Seite oder die Regel, aus der er stammt, damit du ihn direkt beheben kannst. Gebaut für Inhaber kleiner Firmenwebsites und die Leute, die sie betreuen, auf Deutsch und Englisch. Grenzen: nur öffentliche Seiten, nichts hinter einem Login, robots.txt wird respektiert, höchstens 20 Seiten pro Check, Berichte werden 90 Tage aufbewahrt. Kein Sicherheitsscanner.
